headline: Expanse Line Wavers; Colonials Hold Bulk of Works
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has shifted since the last edition: a district counted seven Warden works and two unclaimed three hours ago now reads four Warden, two Colonial and three unclaimed, with seven events in the past two hours and fifty-six across the day. Callahan's Passage has closed to a Warden house entire, ten works of ten, after thirty-nine events in the day and the heaviest filing at Crumbling Post. Palantine Berm remains the busiest desk on the board: six Warden works at the last edition, now five Warden, one Colonial and one unclaimed, forty-eight events in the day and twenty-eight of them at The Droll alone. Stlican Shelf slipped to seven Colonial works with one Warden and one unclaimed. Stonecradle stands eight Colonial to one Warden and the Nevish Line seven Warden to one Colonial, both with recent filings. Marban Hollow and Clahstra report heavy losses with no events filed in the day. Colonials still hold roughly seven works in ten of the four hundred and thirty-six counted. No victory is declared on this, the five hundred and seventeenth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the mark.
